feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Bayern coach Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at training
articles.summary: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany has been taken to hospital after collapsing at the club's training ground.

articles.title: Former Olympic marathon champion suspended after failed drugs test
articles.summary: Former Olympic and world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for the banned substance EPO, officials have said.

articles.title: Seven dead and 34 injured after shooting at church in Jordan
articles.summary: Seven people have died and 34 have been injured after gunmen opened fire on a funeral at a church in Jordan.

articles.title: European football giants to meet in London for NBA basketball talks
articles.summary: A cluster of European football giants will convene in London next week for talks as they try to finalise a string of deals for European basketball teams worth billions of dollars.

articles.title: Israel orders army to prepare to fully close West Bank after two soldiers killed in shooting
articles.summary: The Israeli government has ordered its army to prepare for a full closure of the occupied West Bank following a shooting near Hebron which killed two soldiers.

articles.title: Terror probe after fatal shooting in Paris suburb
articles.summary: A suspect has been arrested after one person was killed and several others wounded in a shooting in an outer suburb of Paris.
